title: Priya Nair's reported resignation
keywords: what does this do to version three

claims.statement: The CEO reported on 19 Nov 2026 (voice note T6d) that Priya Nair ('Pria' in the transcript) resigned that morning. This is second-hand from the CEO, so I have no letter or HR record: Keka (31 Oct export) still shows her as Active with no exit date, and the cockpit leaves it that way until HR records it. Priya is the engineer who carries about 70% of atlas-engine commits (see the concentration answer).
claims.reasoning: The CEO is a direct source for a resignation she was told about, so the event itself is credible. It post-dates every export, so no record can confirm or contradict it. 'Pria' is the same transcription slip as in T1 (alias, High): only one Priya/Pria exists in Keka.

claims.statement: Notice period: the CEO says 'two months, I think'. She is not sure, and Keka has no notice period for Priya. Siddharth's notice (15 Sep to 31 Oct, about 6.5 weeks) is not a guide: the length depends on each contract. So the last working day is unknown. Two months from 19 Nov would be about 19 Jan 2027.
claims.reasoning: A guess by the person reporting it; I cannot test it. I give the arithmetic only as a conditional.

evidence.quote: Notice period two months, I think

claims.statement: What I cannot say: how much this delays Atlas v3, whether the 15 Dec date survives, or whether she can be replaced in time. That is a forecast, and the records do not contain handover plans, her contract, or anything on who could take over the core engine and re-routing. The routing role (REQ-014) is on hold with candidates already in the pipeline. Ask Vikram for a handover plan and whether the 15 Dec date was already at risk.
claims.reasoning: Says what is known and what would have to be asked of Vikram. No prediction is supported by the data.

claims.statement: One update: the CEO reported on 19 Nov that Priya Nair resigned. If confirmed that would be two people on notice; Keka (31 Oct) does not show it, so the roster figure is unchanged.
claims.reasoning: Roster stays as Keka says until HR records the change.

If it is two months from 19 Nov, her last day would be around 19 Jan 2027, but that is arithmetic on a guess. Ask HR for the contract and the resignation letter.
